title: Energy-Constrained Commutator Variance for Weyl Pairs
summary: Let $W$ be a representation of the Weyl relations on a separable Hilbert space and write $\mathcal R_W(K)=\{W(f):f\in K\}''$. If the symplectic pairing of $K_1$ and $K_2$ is nonzero, there is a self-adjoint unitary $B\in\mathcal R_W(K_2)$ such that, for every normal state $ρ$, one can choose a self-adjoint unitary $A_ρ\in\mathcal R_W(K_1)$ with $\operatorname{Var}_ρ(-i[A_ρ,B])=4$. Hence the optimized mean-input-energy-constrained coefficient equals $4$ at every admissible energy threshold.
